LESSON: HOLINESS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Values
Topic 4.6: Holiness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Holiness. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should you lead holy lives as young people?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies
2. recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HOLINESS
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Holiness helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HOLINESS
Study Holiness like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies

What this means
In this part you learn to describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Holiness” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit

What this means
In this part you learn to recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Holiness in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Holiness is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Holiness” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Holiness in your own words. (skill: recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Holiness to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies.
3. Practise this skill: recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Holiness from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Holiness: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Holiness?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you lead holy lives as young people?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Holiness means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies.
5. Be able to: recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
